messages:
Maya Chen: Pausing dedicated rollout for reserved-capacity cluster C7 after p95 jump in canary.
Maya Chen: Merge M-4521 pushed batching heuristic changes + fusion kernel hints; saw 30-45% p95 regression on long-context workloads.
Jordan Lee: Yep, saw it in profiler. Kernel selector chose fusion_v2 on A100S but it forces an extra memcpy for KV layout conversion.
Jordan Lee: Perf counters: `kv_evict_count +312%`, `memcpy_time +40%` on canary.
Priya Patel: infra CI also flagged perf reg failure for matrix_perf_longctx (job 92431). Link: https://ci.redwood/92431
infra-bot: ci/perf-check failed: matrix_perf_longctx p95 +38% vs baseline. Diff: M-4521
Sam Walker: Any chance it's the batching window change? We increased max_batch_wait from 5->8ms in that PR.
Jordan Lee: The window expands microbatches -> more concatenated sequences -> fusion kernel chosen because it looked cheaper for the observed avg_len, but it's terrible for KV heavy sequences.
Priya Patel: Quick log snippet from canary:
```
2026-03-17T04:12:03Z model=llama-70b seq=2048 batch=12 kernel=fusion_v2 memcpy_ms=12.4 kv_evictions=78 p95_ms=324
2026-03-17T04:12:04Z model=llama-70b seq=256 batch=6 kernel=fast_attn memcpy_ms=1.2 kv_evictions=5 p95_ms=42
```
Maya Chen: This is customer impacting — two customers on Dedicated C7 saw tail latency alerts. Recommend immediate rollback of M-4521 from canary -> hold rollout.
Sam Walker: Oncall has been paged. @Jordan @Maya can you bisect to the exact kernel-hint commit? If quick revert available, do it.
Jordan Lee: Starting bisect now. Initial suspicion: commit c3a9f4 added `prefer_fusion_for_batching=true`.
infra-bot: Started bisect job #92498 on canary with kernels pinned.
Priya Patel: Create follow-up INF ticket INF-789 with rollback plan + test to catch KV-evict reg.
Maya Chen: I'll open INF-789 and assign to Jordan + Priya. Also adding a regression perf test: `matrix_perf_longctx_kv_heavy`.
Jordan Lee: If bisect identifies kernel hint as root cause, we can instead add a heuristic: don't prefer fusion if avg_kv_evictions > 10.
Sam Walker: For now revert M-4521 in canary. Ops, confirm revert submitted.
infra-bot: Revert PR #M-4521 applied to canary at 2387654350. Monitoring.
Priya Patel: Monitoring shows p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes. Reverting staging/dedicated full rollout paused until fix.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Next steps: follow-up ticket for improved selector + CI perf test, and an RFC for safe fusion opt-ins.
Jordan Lee: I'll draft quick fix branch to gate prefer_fusion_by_kv.
Sam Walker: Adding customer comms draft to the incident doc.
Maya Chen: Closing thread when DEV confirms hotfix merged. :thumbsup:
